source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building accessibility checks

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Focus on the failed accessibility checks.
    1. For each failed accessibility check, extract the corresponding object (i.e., the object that is being inspected for accessibility).
    2. Fill out a [new issue](https://github.com/OpenSidewalks/opensidewalks-issues/issues/new) for each failed accessibility check.
        1. In the issue title, describe the failed accessibility check.
            ```md
            Describe which check failed, as well as the specific accessibility deficiency (e.g., curb ramp lacks detectable warning)
            ```
        2. In the issue description, copy the relevant survey results.
            ```md
            Insert a survey section that shows the failed result.
            ```
        3. In the issue body, fill out the following template.
            ```md
            ## Where is the issue?
            ## What is the problem?
